data.title: AI executives planning "day after" scenarios following possible catastrophic event, Axios reports
data.description: New reporting from Axios reveals that leaders at artificial intelligence companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are planning behind the scenes for fallout scenarios should a significant AI cyberattack occur. Axios tech policy reporter Maria Curi has the details.
data.keywords: Technology, United States Congress, OpenAI, Axios, Meta, Claude, Artificial Intelligence, ChatGPT, Anthropic
